## Overview

An inline message for Vanta 1.x. Vanta 2 replaced `kind` with the required `tone` input.

- **Kind:** Component
- **Stability:** `deprecated`
- **Since:** 1.0

## Selector

```text
vanta-alert
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"info" \| "warning" \| "danger"` | `'info'` |  | Visual intent of the 1.x alert; defaults to `info`. |
| `heading` | `string` | `''` |  | Short heading shown above the message. |

## Outputs

| Output | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `closed` | `void` | Emits when the reader closes the alert. |
